responses.text: OutSpec's docstring now says that E = tol comes from the exact partial sums, each chunk's largest lifted product and each chunk's exact magnitude chunkAbs (the second arm of DotE5m2ChunkLoss's minimum). Wording only: no definition changed, and the gate digest is the same. With it I also fixed r-e5m2's remark on the README's randn figures at K = 4096: the tolerance is below |S| on roughly 40-50% of draws (10 of my 20, about 40% of r-e5m2's 200), not on half, and the sentence on fixing the sign says the same.
